verdict.rationale: Circle publishes machine-readable OpenAPI YAML specs per product under developers.circle.com/openapi/: compliance, gateway, smart-contract-platform, stablefx, cpn-ofi, user-controlled and developer-controlled wallets, cctp and xreserve. The probe's 404s on generic paths like /openapi.json only show the specs aren't at conventional locations; they don't contradict that the specs exist. Missing for 10: a single unified spec or well-known discovery path (the standard openapi.json/.well-known paths 404), and a documented download/index page or independent corroboration of spec completeness.
